Things change when Willy Wonka, head of the very popular Wonka Chocolate empire, announces a contest in which five gold tickets have been hidden in chocolate bars. Charlie is one of the five kids who find a lucky ticket and goes on a tour of Wonka's chocolate factory.

programme.title: Johnny English Reborn
programme.desc: A haphazard spy returns to MI-7 after years in a Tibetan monastery honing his Zen skills. Armed with gizmos, gadgets and chaotic luck he takes on a global ring of assassins.

programme.desc: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

programme.desc: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shopkeeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shopkeeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.

programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
programme.desc: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.

Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

programme.title: The Wizard of Oz
programme.desc: Perennial family favourite about Dorothy, a young girl from the American Midwest, who is swept by a cyclone to a magical kingdom over the rainbow. There she meets a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion, who join her on a quest to find the all-powerful Wizard of Oz, the only man who can help her get back to Kansas. However, the Wicked Witch of the West has other plans for Dorothy and her new friends.

programme.title: Charlotte's Web
programme.desc: After learning that a young pig's days are numbered, a literate spider weaves an elaborate plan to save her friend from the butcher's block.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics

programme.title: The World's End

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop

To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: he packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

programme.title: Big Daddy

After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Hungama
programme.desc: A trio in love triangle, a couple from the countryside, a disgruntled crime lord, and a myriad of other eccentric characters dance to a cacophony of reckless lies and misunderstandings.

programme.title: Kaala Patthar
programme.desc: Branded a coward for abandoning his ship full of 300 passengers, Captain Vijay Pal Singh takes up work in a distant coal mine, poorly equipped, with no sufficient medical supplies or proper facilities. When the miners and their families face a catastrophe, as water has forced its way into one of the mining tunnels, endangering 400 lives, will Vijay be able to rise to the occasion or will he 'abandon ship' again?

programme.title: Prahaar
programme.desc: Patriotic Major Chauchan has spent most of his life defending his country. Used to dealing with external threats on the battlefield, he is shocked to discover the corruption within his own society, when one of his commandos is murdered and the police do nothing about it. Chauchan's new war is in his own country, and instead of soldiers, he is fighting the apathy and corruption in the police force and politicians.

programme.title: Kya Super Kool Hai Hum
programme.desc: Sid, Adi and Sackru the dog return and try to find love, with hilarious and shambolic consequences.

programme.title: Sanam Bewafa

programme.title: What the Fish
programme.desc: A grumpy old woman travels abroad and puts her niece in charge of her house in Delhi, only to return to utter chaos and mess.

programme.title: Shamshera
programme.desc: In the face of oppression, Shamshera emerges as a powerful movement for a tribe of warriors. Years after his death, his son Balli must continue the legacy.

programme.title: Highway
programme.desc: Right before her wedding, a young woman finds herself abducted and held for ransom. As the initial days pass, she begins to develop a strange bond with her kidnapper.

programme.title: Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari
programme.desc: Heartbroken after their partners, Ananya and Vikram, abandon them to marry each other, Sunny and Tulsi team up to crash the wedding of their exes.

programme.title: Satte Pe Satta
programme.desc: After the death of his parents, Ravi Anand, the eldest of seven, takes it upon himself to raise his brothers.

programme.title: Raja Shivaji
programme.desc: A young warrior's dream of establishing a sovereign Maratha kingdom is challenged by the Mughal and Adil Shahi empires.

programme.title: Fighter

programme.title: Ek Aur Singham: The Real Police Cop
programme.desc: An honest police officer works zealously to fight against corruption and evil politicians who break the laws of the nation.

programme.title: Bal Hanuman IV - Attack of the Universe
programme.desc: Chhote Maharaj organises a kabaddi match between monkeys and crocodiles, but the cunning crocodiles hatch a plan to revive the dreaded demon crocodile king with the help of their new alien allies.

programme.title: Akhiyon Se Goli Maare
programme.desc: Topichand Bhangare owns an antique store as a front for his illegal activities. He wishes his only daughter, Sulekha, to be married to a gangster, but she is in love with another man who has no links to the underworld. The young man, Raj Oberoi, is tasked to become a gangster in order to win the hand of his daughter.

programme.title: Dil To Pagal Hai
programme.desc: Rahul is the director of a successful music and dance group and considers Nisha his best friend. Secretly, she is madly in love with him. Following an injury, new dancer Pooja joins the company and Rahul finds himself falling for her, but she is engaged to Ajay who is the son of the family who raised Pooja following her parents' death. As preparations for the new show progress, will Rahul decide on a happy ending?

programme.title: Dhoom
programme.desc: A gang of robbers on hi-tech motorbikes, led by the charismatic Kabir, is sweeping through Mumbai, outwitting the police at every turn. When officer Jai Dixit is assigned to catch the criminals, he reluctantly enlists the help of garage mechanic and bike enthusiast Ali. Though the pair do not see eye-to-eye at first, they soon become a formidable team, tracking their enemies from the streets of Mumbai to the beaches of Goa.
